subject: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check

Sarah —

Quick ping as we head into fiscal close: finance asked for explicit stage alignment across our committed Q2 deals so they can bake the forecast. Can you confirm the stage and committed close date for the ACME SOW we discussed? Specifically we need:

- Final approval date from procurement (if set)
- Any remaining legal/PO blockers and the owners
- Whether the SOW we sent (attached) needs changes or will be signed as-is

I've attached the latest SOW draft for reference (ACME_Q2_SOW_v3.pdf). If the date is slipping, please indicate whether this is a timing shift (yellow) or at-risk (red) so we can surface it in the weekly commit review.

Next steps on our side: Karthik will coordinate any technical due diligence items and Monica will update the forecast rollup once we have your confirmation. Can we get a quick reply today with the stage + one-line blocker summary?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: ACME_Q2_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]

From: Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Finance Ops <finance-ops@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check

Rafael —

Thanks for the note and the SOW. Quick update from our side:

- Procurement still needs final review; target is EOD Mon 04/29 but that is contingent on one clarifying item around data retention language.
- Legal flagged a narrow KMS integration clause; our legal ops will share a suggested redline by tomorrow.
- Finance has tentatively earmarked budget for May but wants a signed SOW before they finalize the P&L entry.

I would classify this as YELLOW right now — on track but dependent on the legal/KMS clarification.

I can loop in our procurement lead if that helps accelerate; would you like me to do that or should we route technical details to Karthik?

--
Sarah Liu
Director, Cloud Platforms | Acme Corporation
s.liu@acme.com | (212) 555-0103

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check — status and next actions

Karthik / Monica —

Forwarding Sarah's update. Key takeaways and asks: 

- Status: YELLOW (procurement review + legal KMS clause)
- Owner asks: Karthik, please confirm whether the KMS integration clause is something we can accommodate without engineering changes or if it requires an ops design (quick estimate). If it needs design time, give a rough ETA.
- Monica, please flag ACME as YELLOW in the forecast spreadsheet and hold the commit as conditional pending the signed SOW; include a one-line rationale for the commit review.

I've attached a small deal-risk matrix I put together to help the weekly review (deal-risk-matrix.csv) — populate the "owner" and "mitigation" columns where relevant.

Suggested mitigation steps for the weekly commit review (short):
- Immediate: Karthik to confirm KMS compatibility (today)
- 24–48h: Legal redline resolution (Sarah to coordinate with their legal ops)
- 72h: If unresolved, propose a limited-scope signature (ops appendix) to allow finance to book partial revenue

Ping me if you want me to join a quick sync with Acme procurement. I'll be available after 2pm.

— Rafael

[Attachment: deal-risk-matrix.csv (csv, 4KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check — status and next actions

Rafael — quick status:

- The KMS clause Sarah flagged maps to our existing KMS integration options (AWS KMS and GCP CMEK). No code changes required; it's a configuration & key-handling ops step.
- Ops estimate: 1 business day to validate key rotation policy and provide required config snippets; 2 days if we need to run a short compliance review with our security team.
- I'll draft the config language and send to Sarah by EOD for legal to include in the SOW.

Monica — I'll put myself as owner on the matrix for mitigation steps and will add the config snippet to the shared Drive link Rafael included. If we hit legal pushback, we default to limited-scope appendix as Rafael suggested.

-- Karthik

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.com>, Acme Finance Ops <finance-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2024 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Q2 stage alignment & risk check

Sarah — thanks for the quick reply and the status. Per Karthik below, we can accommodate the KMS language without engineering changes; Karthik will send a suggested config snippet for legal to slot into the SOW by EOD today.

Action summary: 
- Karthik: config snippet + owner entry in matrix (EOD today)
- Monica: mark ACME as YELLOW in the forecast and include the one-line rationale before the close cadence (done)
- Sarah: await Karthik's snippet and share legal redline back to us; if legal requests changes we can discuss a limited-scope appendix to keep finance comfortable.

If that timeline holds, finance is comfortable treating this as conditional commit for the weekly rollup. I'll follow up in the commit review tomorrow with a one-line update.

Thanks again — appreciate the collaboration.

Best,
Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
